title: Decathlon UK RCR-F Pro 105 Di2 grey 8913505 field-scope recheck
notes: Exact UK 8913505 page: 8.2 kg size M with tubeless assembly, 1,010 g gross frame in M and 420 g gross fork, with further inclusions/protocol unstated. HADRON² Classic 625 wheels: 62 mm rims, listed front/rear masses 848/996 g. Fitted Aero 111 TLR 26 mm front and GP5000 S TR 28 mm rear are distinct from the 32 mm maximum. R7100 component details include 52/36, 11–34 and INPEAK-E left-crank sensing. These UK observations do not establish mainland BOM, weight, checkout or warranty. The stated 7% front-stiffness increase is relative brand marketing without an absolute public protocol.
